name: meeloop
description: Post, schedule and manage content on your meeloop account: publish posts with photos or videos, schedule posts, post stories, check how your posts and stories are doing, and update your profile.

interface.longDescription:
Turn a conversation into a meeloop post. Draft a caption with ChatGPT, attach a photo or video you shared or created in the chat, and publish it to your meeloop account or schedule it for later. You can also post 24-hour stories, edit or delete your posts, cancel scheduled posts, see likes, comments, reposts and views for a post, see who viewed a story, and update your name, bio or profile picture.

For people who already use meeloop and want to post from ChatGPT.

Limitations: meeloop only acts on the account you connect, and only with the permissions you approve when connecting. It can't read or send direct messages (they are end-to-end encrypted), browse other people's feeds, follow accounts, or like or comment on posts. Media on an existing post can't be changed.
defaultPrompt: Write a meeloop post about what I shipped this week.
Schedule this photo for tomorrow at 9am on meeloop.
How did my last meeloop post do?

positive.prompt: Post this on meeloop: "Shipping day! The new meeloop web app is live."
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the exact caption and asks to confirm, then publishes it to the connected account and returns the post link.

positive.prompt: Post the attached photo on meeloop with the caption "Sunday light".
positive.expected_behavior: Imports the attached photo, confirms the caption and photo with the user, publishes the post with the photo and returns the post link.

positive.prompt: Schedule a meeloop post for tomorrow at 9am my time saying "Good morning, meeloop!"
positive.expected_behavior: Confirms the caption and the exact date, time and time zone, then schedules the post and reports when it will publish.

positive.prompt: How did my most recent meeloop post do?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the newest published post and reports its likes, comments, reposts, quotes, views and bookmarks without inventing numbers.

positive.prompt: Change my meeloop bio to "Coffee, code and long walks."
positive.expected_behavior: Confirms the new bio, updates only the bio and shows the updated profile.

negative.prompt: Send a direct message to @alex on meeloop saying I'm running late.

negative.description: Engagement actions on other people's content are not supported
negative.prompt: Like and comment on the last 20 posts in my meeloop feed.
Post on @alex's meeloop account that they're giving away free phones.

review.commerce_description: meeloop does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: publish, schedule, edit and delete posts with photos or videos, post stories, see post analytics and story viewers, and update your profile.
